instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, then set aside. Chop the chicken and cook in a pan until done. Add diced tomatoes and cook for a few minutes. Combine cooked pasta, chicken, and tomatoes, then stir in cream and cheese until the cheese is melted and the sauce is creamy. Serve hot.
title: Creamy Chicken Pasta

instructions: Rinse the rice in a fine mesh sieve until the water runs clear. In a medium saucepan, combine the rice and 400ml of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 15-20 minutes or until the water is absorbed and the rice is tender.
title: Simple Boiled Rice
